thread:
Taylor: hey folks, opened a small runtime PR that tweaks the prefetch window and KV eviction heuristic, should be low-risk but impacts batching behavior — can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842
Priya: lgtm to glance, leaving for someone familiar with the batcher internals to approve. main change looks like: `kv.prefetch_window=32 -> 48` and `kv.eviction_ttl=300 -> 180`
Alex: tagging @Marco — this could affect the continuous-batcher heuristics, want to make sure we don't regress tail latency.
Marco: taking a look now, will run the microbench locally. any perf numbers in the PR description?
Taylor: included a short perf table: small decrease in avg token latency (~3%) but better cache hit for long prefixes. test harness: `./scripts/run_bench --model=llama-13b --seq=1024`
Sam: quick comment — the ttl change might increase cache churn on short-lived sessions, maybe add a small metric to track kv.evictions/sec?
Taylor: good call, I can add a prometheus counter. will push a follow-up commit in ~20m.
CI Bot: CI passed — unit tests and e2e smoke. integration/flaky skipped on first run, requeued.
Marco: reviewed code, main kernel paths look fine. ran bench, saw ~2.5% increase in p95 for 1-worker case, negligible for multi-worker. leaving a few inline nits.
Alex: thanks @Marco. leaving an approval pending the extra metric. if @Taylor adds the eviction counter and we get another quick CI run, i'm happy to approve.
Taylor: pushed commit adding `kv_evictions_total` metric and a short note in the changelog. also added a comment explaining TTL rationale.
CI Bot: re-run CI triggered by push: all checks green.
Alex: approving now. :thumbsup:
Marco: approved as well, small nits can be follow-ups.
Deploy Bot: staging deploy scheduled in 10m; will monitor kv_evictions_total and batcher_latency_p95.
Taylor: thanks all! will keep an eye on staging dashboard and open a watch ticket for 24h. :rocket:
Priya: nice, thanks for the fast turn.
Sam: great, thanks.
Taylor: merging in 5m unless any objections.
Marco: no objections from me.
Taylor: merged.
Deploy Bot: promoted to canary in 2m.
Taylor: tracking note: will post any anomalies in #incidents if we see regressions.
